verdict.rationale: Factory ships infrastructure that could support this (droid exec designed for CI/CD pipelines, autonomous diff proposals, and /readiness-fix for fixing failing criteria), and Droid can analyze PRs/MRs and post review feedback, but there is no explicit documented workflow where a failed CI run is automatically diagnosed and a fix PR is proposed end-to-end. missing for 10: a named feature/workflow that triggers on CI failure, diagnoses root cause, and opens a PR with the fix; independent/hands-on evidence of this specific flow working.
